# kuwai

> Liquid-glass Hyprland 0.57 (Lua) and Quickshell (QML) desktop environment built for developers running coding agents, featuring a Dynamic Island status bar, native permission approvals, atomic theming, and automated visual regression verification.

## Pages
- [Home](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/): Interactive Dynamic Island showcase, the v0.1.0 release, captured UI surfaces, measured resource headroom, and side-by-side install guide.
- [Changelog](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/changelog): Release history and verified milestones.
- [Brand Kit](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/brand): Official SVG marks, wordmarks, liquid-glass design tokens, and Open Graph previews.

## Syndication
- [RSS 2.0 Feed](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/feed.xml)

## Key Facts (v0.1.0)
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later (https://github.com/KitsuneKode/kuwai)
- Platform: Arch Linux, Hyprland 0.57 (Lua), Quickshell (QtQuick/QML), systemd user units
- Session isolation: Installs to ~/.config/kuwai/hypr/ as its own login session without modifying ~/.config/hypr
- Design system: Zero hardcoded token drift, Inter optical sizes default (SF Pro optional), critically damped springs, 141-frame automated visual checks
- Agent integration: Dedicated orange approval capsule, native PermissionRequest hooks, multi-profile quota tracking across Claude, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Grok, Gemini, and Devin
